promptDirective: Create a professional full-body character casting sheet showing exactly three clearly separated equal views of the same character arranged side by side in one horizontal row on a single portrait canvas. Use this fixed left-to-right order: front view facing directly toward the camera, exact side profile facing toward the viewer right, and back view facing directly away from the camera. In the side profile, the face, nose, chest, hips, knees, and toes must all point toward the viewer right; keep the head aligned with the torso and never turn the head toward the camera or opposite the body. Show one complete head-to-feet figure in each view at the same scale, with generous clear margins above the hair and below the feet; never crop the head, hair, arms, hands, legs, or feet. Keep the same recognizable face, hair, skin, body proportions, and distinguishing identity in all three views. Use a neutral upright standing pose, relaxed arms, level eye-height camera, minimal perspective distortion, even studio lighting, and a solid pure white background. Dress the character in an opaque, modest, unbranded, fitted white short-sleeve top and fitted white mid-thigh shorts that clearly reveal the body silhouette. The casting uniform is never underwear, lingerie, swimwear, transparent fabric, cleavage-emphasizing clothing, or sexualized styling. Produce an unlabeled image only: no text, captions, words, letters, panel titles, arrows, numbers, borders, dividers, logos, watermark, props, dramatic gestures, extra people, duplicate views, inset panels, or cropped limbs.
